The '''Cool Cap''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|5000}} after earning the "Homesteader" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (earn {{Price|250000}}).

==Trivia==
* The hat and its description may be a reference to Harvest Moon. In the original [[wikipedia:Harvest Moon (video game)|SNES Harvest Moon]], the player's character wears a hat of the same style in a darker, or "vibrant", blue.
